signal: Nextech was acquired by TPG for $1.4B and launched its AI Cora Scribe, signaling aggressive growth and GTM expansion across specialty healthcare.

email.body1:
Armin, saw Nextech is scaling fast under TPG's $1.4B acquisition and just shipped the AI Cora Scribe.

Growth at that pace usually means more in-market practices than your team can reach before signal goes stale, and that latency between intent and action is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Armin, quick follow-up for Nextech.

Most RevOps teams sit on plenty of intent data but lose it to follow-up latency, where a hot account cools before a rep ever touches it. The lift compounds when every signal triggers a researched, personalized touch automatically instead of waiting in a queue.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Armin, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nextech's reply rate likely compares to similar growth-stage software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Armin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-acquisition, I know the integration work alone can eat a calendar.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Nextech either way.
